title: The Hull Field
text: A flat basin on Ash with thirty-three probe hulls in three rows: eleven Accord, eleven Kindred, eleven Engram, one design under three paints, numbered down each row (ACCORD 11, ACCORD 10…), the oldest sunk deepest. Eighteen stand in the rows, two have slumped into a pit to the south-west (ACCORD 1 among them, its drone bay welded shut from the inside) and thirteen are buried where the rows run on west under the ash. Kindred hulls carry cryo racks, opened from outside; Engram hulls carry data vaults, wiped. At the east end of each row an empty berth, swept and levelled: ours is stencilled ACCORD 12, and under it LEDGER 12, which leads to Vess. Earlier Accords (relic towers stencilled with filed-off run numbers) guard our berth.
